description: Add a product to the shopping cart. Omit cart_token to start a new cart — the response's cart_token must be carried into every later cart, delivery, and checkout call. The price is re-validated live at this moment and again at checkout; if it changed, checkout reports prices_changed instead of placing the order.

cart_token.description: From a previous add_to_cart response. Omit to start a new cart.

city_id.description: Destination city ID for local currency pricing. Default: 414 (Moscow).

product_id.description: Product ID from search_products or get_product_details.

name: add_to_cart

cart_token.description: Carry into get_cart, update_cart_item, estimate_delivery, get_checkout_url and checkout.

price.description: Unit price at this moment; checkout re-validates it.
